title: Biome chest weapons: Piranha Gun, Scourge of the Corruptor, Vampire Knives, Rainbow Gun, Staff of the Frost Hydra, Desert Tiger Staff
player_outcome: The six legendary dungeon-vault weapons exist and play like Terraria's: latching piranhas, javelins that burst into tiny eaters, life-stealing knife fans, a rainbow beam, a frost-hydra sentry and a desert-tiger minion.
design: ProjectileDef.Latch (bool; the projectile sticks to the npc it hits, keeps its offset and deals its damage every LatchInterval ticks until its lifetime ends) in ProjectileSystem.Special.cs.
New ProjectileHitSpecs: 'lifeSteal' {fraction} (heals the owner) and 'spawnProjectiles' {projectile, count, speed, homing}.
scourge_of_the_corruptor: thrown javelin; onHit spawns 3 homing 'tiny_eater'.
rainbow_gun: a slow piercing rainbow bolt with a long trail.
staff_of_the_frost_hydra: a sentry (minion speed 0) shooting frost bolts.
desert_tiger_staff: a minion (a pouncing tiger); reuse the minion system.
Models and icons via existing generators (gun, staff, knife) with bespoke params.
files_add: data/items/biome_chest_weapons.json — six weapons and their projectiles
data_changes: Six hardmode weapons and their projectiles.
risks: Overlaps the items phase's projectile and animation work (muzzle sockets, trails). Keep the mechanics in Core and leave the visuals to that phase.
